recent_news.headline: Phillips 66 and Restaurant Technologies expand used cooking oil supply for sustainable aviation fuel
recent_news.summary: Phillips 66 and Restaurant Technologies entered a long-term agreement to supply used cooking oil from restaurants for renewable fuel production at the Phillips 66 Rodeo Renewable Energy Complex in California. Restaurant Technologies collects UCO from more than 45,000 foodservice operations across 41 markets. The feedstock will be processed into renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel.

recent_news.headline: Cooking oil recycling day and food drive coming up
recent_news.summary: The Evansville Water and Sewer Utility will host its 5th annual Used Cooking Oil Recycling Day on November 28. The event addresses FOG (fats, oils, and grease) disposal challenges, which cause sewer blockages and expensive repairs when improperly discarded.

recent_news.headline: Major Federal Water Infrastructure Funding Lapsed Sept. 30
recent_news.summary: IIJA's five-year authorization and supplemental funding period for Clean Water and Drinking Water State Revolving Funds ended September 30, 2026, creating uncertainty for water and wastewater infrastructure projects. The Clean Water SRF provides low-cost loans for wastewater treatment plants, collection systems, and stormwater controls.
